title: Who you know
emptySelf: Name yourself so Isoform can tell your messages from everyone else's.
deleteDescription: Isoform removes this person and the chat accounts tied to them. Memories and activity that mention them keep the name.
mergeDescription: Pick who this really is. Everything Isoform knows about them moves to that person. You can undo this.
cleanupStep1Body: newsletters, alerts and bots aren't people, so they're removed.
cleanupStep2Body: times, badges and stray message text come off their names.
cleanupStep3Body: senders left with the same name become one, with their messages together.
cleanupFootnote: You and the people you've named stay as they are.
voicePrintEnrolledHint: Isoform checks what your mic hears against your voice. Speech that doesn't match is treated as someone else's.
voicePrintEmptyHint: Record a short sample so Isoform can tell your voice from others near your mic.
voicePrintTestHintMatch: Isoform recognizes your voice here. If that changes, record a new sample where you are.
voicePrintTestHintNoMatch: Isoform didn't recognize your voice, so it would treat it as someone else's. A different mic, a noisy room or a cold can cause this. Record a new sample here.
dossierEmpty: Isoform can write a short profile of them from what it knows.
contactsImportButtonTitle: Choose people you already know from Contacts or a vCard file
contactsImportDescription: Choose contacts from this computer, or import a vCard file.
contactsImportConsentWhy: So Isoform can recognize the people you already know in meetings and messages.
contactsImportConsentWhat: Isoform reads all contact names, photos, phone numbers and email addresses from this computer. After you allow access, it saves them quietly and checks for changes when the app starts and every six hours.
contactsImportConsentWhere: Contacts are saved on this computer and help recognize people in your computer and phone experience. Their details may be included in context sent to your chosen assistant.
contactsImportConsentNever: Imported people are never researched automatically.
contactsImportConsentAccept: I agree to let Isoform save and keep my contacts in sync.
contactsFileConsentAccept: I agree to let Isoform import contacts from this file.
contactsImportConsentFailed: Couldn't save your consent. No contacts were read.
contactsImportConsentSummary: All contacts are saved and kept in sync on this computer. Their details may be shared with your chosen assistant and used in your phone experience. Imported people are never researched automatically.
contactsImportPermissionGrantHint: macOS asks once. You can change this later in System Settings.
contactsImportSettingsFailed: Couldn't open System Settings. Open Privacy & Security, Contacts yourself.
contactsImportPermissionDenied: Isoform cannot read Contacts. Turn on Isoform under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Contacts, then choose Try again here.
contactsImportPermissionRestricted: Contacts access is restricted on this computer, so Isoform cannot read them. You can still import a vCard file.
contactsImportLoadFailed: Could not read your contacts. Try again.
contactsImportResult: Imported {{imported}}, merged {{merged}} with people you already have, and skipped {{skipped}}.
contactsImportErrors: Some contact details couldn't be saved.
contactsImportFailed: Could not import these contacts. Try again.
contactsImportVCardHint: Choose a .vcf file exported from your address book.
contactsImportUnavailable: Contacts sync is not available on this computer.
contactsImportRemoveDescription: Isoform removes the {{count}} people created by address-book imports. Existing people you matched and contacts imported from vCard files are kept. This computer’s address book is not changed.
contactsSyncRemoveDescription: Imported contacts and their linked details will be removed. Existing people and their original handles will stay. Automatic syncing will pause until you connect Contacts again.
contactsSyncNeedsAccess: Isoform can't read Contacts on this computer.
contactLinkDescription: Search contacts imported from this computer. Linking brings their details to this person on your computer and phone. You can unlink later.
contactLinkSearch: Search by name, phone or email
contactsFileConsentWhat: Isoform reads the names, phone numbers and email addresses in a contact file you choose. Contacts from a file are saved on this computer; file imports do not refresh automatically.
contactsFileConsentSummary: Contacts from a file are saved on this computer. Their details may be shared with your chosen assistant and used in your phone experience. Imported people are never researched automatically.

overview.subline_one: {{count}} person. Anyone with something open comes first.
overview.subline_other: {{count}} people. Anyone with something open comes first.
overview.headlinePaused: Observing is paused, so what’s open between you is hidden
overview.headlineNothingOwed: You don’t owe anyone right now
overview.headlineNothingOpen: Nothing is open between you and anyone
overview.unidentifiedHint: Senders Isoform could not match to a person. Open one to name it, or clean them all up from here.
overview.sortLine_one: Isoform couldn't tell who {{count}} sender is.
overview.sortLine_other: Isoform couldn't tell who {{count}} senders are.
overview.pickDesc: Each person shows what is open between you, your history together and where Isoform saw them.
overview.dayZero: People appear here as you work with them.

loopLine.reappeared: Back in touch after a quiet stretch

merge.reasonHandle: Same {{app}} account under different display names: {{names}}.
merge.reasonEmail: Same email address under different names: {{names}}.
merge.failedLinked: One of these profiles is linked to a contact. Unlink it from that person's More menu, then merge.

detail.label: Person detail
detail.selfSummary: This is you. Isoform uses it to tell your own messages and voice apart from everyone else’s.
detail.briefNothing: Nothing to add before you talk.

firstDay.more: More appear as you work with them.

voicePrintDeleteDescription: Isoform stops using it to recognize your voice.
dossierDeleteDescription: Isoform can write a new one later.
contactsSyncStopped: Contacts sync stopped. It runs again within 6 hours.
contactsSyncStopFailed: Couldn't stop. Contacts are still syncing.
